title: Whirling knight's tours with n coils and with n/2 coils
scope: n coils: nonexistence for all n >= 5 not divisible by 4; explicit tours for the multiples of 4 from 12 to 48; n >= 28 quoted from Knuth's draft. n/2 coils: existence for every n >= 16 with n = 0 or 2 (mod 8), by explicit tours for n <= 90 and a ring construction from six seed tours for n >= 96; nonexistence in the other cases is due to S. Li and to Knuth's counts.
gate_basis: Exact verification scripts pass (verify_weights.py for 5 <= n <= 70; check_tour.py on the n-coil tours; half_family.py: 20 explicit tours, conditions (Z),(S),(W),(C) for six seeds, direct checks of every admissible n <= 570 and of n = 1000). Independent AI referee passes re-implemented the checks from the text. A third AI referee pass (2026-11-16), given only the paper and the data files, found no mathematical error in the n/2-coil section, confirmed conditions (Z), (S), (W), (C) for the six seeds, and checked the construction directly for every admissible n from 72 to 810 and for n = 1000. No external review.
dependencies: Python 3.10+ standard library for check_tour.py and verify_weights.py.
python-sat (CaDiCaL), numpy, scipy and matplotlib for the search, LP and figure scripts.
limitations: Not externally peer reviewed. Checks so far: exact verification scripts, and independent re-implementations from the text of the paper by separate AI agents. A third AI referee pass (2026-11-16), given only the paper and the data files, found no mathematical error in the n/2-coil section, confirmed conditions (Z), (S), (W), (C) for the six seeds, and checked the construction directly for every admissible n from 72 to 810 and for n = 1000.

n coils: the existence direction for n >= 28 is quoted from Knuth's draft (answer 232, Beluhov and Stappers) and was not re-derived; tours for multiples of 4 up to 48 are supplied independently. The cases n = 4 and n = 8 rest on exhaustive enumeration (Knuth's counts, reproduced by whirl_sat.py).

n/2 coils: nonexistence is not ours (Li's theorem; Knuth's counts for n = 8, 10). The existence proof is computer-assisted: the six seeds were found by SAT search, and the proof for all n rests on a lemma plus finite conditions that half_family.py checks.
The table of least coil numbers for other n is computational only: tours are verified, but the absence of tours with fewer coils rests on the SAT solver's answers.

We found no published construction for n/2 coils, but cannot rule out that one is known to others (Beluhov, Stappers) and unpublished. Knuth's site was unreachable on 2026-11-16, so we could not check for a newer draft.
The n-coil proof technique (closed-form Farkas certificates for a cycle-cover LP relaxation) follows S. Li, arXiv:2605.04603.
Knuth's draft is cited, not reproduced. Priority has not been established by an external party.
